versions.name: Amharic Bible JSON (edition unspecified)
versions.notes: Repository contains a complete Amharic Bible JSON and an MIT LICENSE, but its README says the text was downloaded from WordProject and partly filled from GeezExperience. The repository license alone does not establish rights to redistribute the underlying Bible translation. It is not labeled as 1954 or አዲሱ መደበኛ, so it must not be used for either edition until provenance and edition are verified.
